# Health

Check the health of the controller.
`osapi controller endpoint get --name health` shows the same.

## Endpoint group

|             |                                    |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Name        | health                             |
| Description | Check the health of the controller |

### Methods (3)

| NAME     | VERB | PATH               | PERMISSION    | OPERATION ID    |
| -------- | ---- | ------------------ | ------------- | --------------- |
| liveness | GET  | /api/health        | none (public) | GetHealth       |
| ready    | GET  | /api/health/ready  | none (public) | GetHealthReady  |
| status   | GET  | /api/health/status | health:read   | GetHealthStatus |

### Types (3)

| NAME     | INPUT         | OUTPUT                                                                                                                                    |
| -------- | ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| liveness | LivenessInput | HealthResponse &#123; status &#125;                                                                                                       |
| ready    | ReadyInput    | ReadyResponse &#123; status, error &#125;                                                                                                 |
| status   | StatusInput   | StatusResponse &#123; status, version, uptime, checks, registry, jobs, streams, kv_buckets, object_stores, consumers, nats, agents &#125; |
